name: static/long-tail
description: Long-tail static utilities not previously fixtured: touch-action (named modes + cascade-var directional modes), will-change, forced-color-adjust, scroll-snap-type/strictness/align/stop, background-blend-mode. The `touch-pan-*` and `snap-{x,y,both}` families write `--tw-*` cascade vars and emit composed shorthand referencing the vars, mirroring upstream.
